posts.en:
want-a-init is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Model-driven /init command: the agent analyzes the current repo and generates/updates a high-signal AGENTS.md, with a persistent system-prompt reminder to keep it maintained.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e9fc0ac6c57836c3af6f.html
